_meta.note: Two POST /state calls to the same room, same X-Group-Key, using the same display name. The relay stores members by name, so the second call silently replaces the first (docs/GROUP_RELAY.md: 'publishing again under the same name replaces your previous entry').

sequence.actor: impostor holding the same room key

scenario.modeledEffect: Every other room member's next /state reply lists one entry named MaxGooner at (5.0, 5.0) — the impostor's position — with no indication the identity changed hands.
